{{Quote|Those who fear to lose their power are made tyrants by war.''"<br />"''All who make war are tyrants, Jedi. Even your heart I wonder for. Do you fight for us or for the agrocite? If you have come to secure the ore for your Republic, I will not judge.|Kit Fisto and Adaroo|<ref name="TCW7" />}}
The '''Khormai''', the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] characterized by their stout physiques, [[blubber]]y skin, bushy mustaches, and prominent [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]]. Khormai often wore robust [[Khormai environment suit|environment suits]] that sported large smoke stacks, which emitted plumes of [[Color/Legends|gray]] gas. Members of the species traveled between their disparate [[City/Legends|settlements]] via transports known as [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jets]], or from within the [[Stomach/Legends|gullets]] of large, [[Hair/Legends|furry]] [[Worm/Legends|worms]] known as [[aelid]]s, whom Khormai could summon with a special [[Aelid horn|instrument]]. A wide degree of dispositions marked the species, with some supporting war and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]], yet others peace. The species and their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] held great strategic value in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] due to the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] of [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]], an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] with important military uses.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an ambitious Khormai [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] named [[Unger Gout]] capitalized on Khorm's agrocite deposits to broker a deal with the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]: in exchange for control of the planet, Gout enslaved his own people to mine agrocite for the Separatists. Gout employed a [[weather-control station]] to create massive storms in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and thus control when [[Starship/Legends|starships]] could make landfall. Meanwhile, a rival Khormai, [[Adaroo]], took control of a [[Khormai resistance|resistance movement]]. A force of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managed to land on the world, where they teamed up with Adaroo to lead an assault on Gout's location. Although bumbling by the Republic [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] nearly lost them the mission, Adaroo and the Republic forces defeated Gout and his reinforcements, [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] led by the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. The planet returned to Republic hands.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Warlord_Gout.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Khormai head joined the torso in rolls of fat.]]
With both [[Gender/Legends|male and female]] members, the Khormai were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], rotund [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Their bodies were covered in thick skin that ranged in [[Color/Legends|color]] from dull<ref name="TCW7" /> to rich brown,<ref name="DHOSJ">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref> the hide riddled with wrinkles and pockmarks.<ref name="TCW7" /> The Khormai's stocky [[Limb/Legends|legs]] stood them roughly 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall on average,<ref name="height" /> and their flipper-like hands boasted either three<ref name="TCW7" /> or four fingers each.<ref name="TCW9">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref> The [[Species/Legends|species's]] girth enabled them to wield large weapons.<ref name="TCW7" />

The species' characteristic dome-shaped head attached to the fat, broad neck in [[blubber]]y folds. Wide-set [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], white with no discernible irises, flanked a small [[Nose/Legends|nose]] shaped like an inverted triangle; the nasal opening was either pink<ref name="TCW7" /> or black in coloration.<ref name="DHOSJ" /> Although the mouth sported a full set of white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], it was dominated by two stubby, white tusks that jutted out from the upper [[Bone/Legends|jaw]], itself covered by a white [[Hair/Legends|mustache]]. The chin and neck also sported a thin coating of white stubble. Tiny [[Ear/Legends|ear]] flaps extended from the sides of the head.<ref name="TCW7" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|My people have long used these ice worms&mdash;aelids&mdash;to traverse these mountains.''"<br />"''And we use these control straps as we ride on top of them?''"<br />"''We don't ride on the worms, Master Jedi. We ride in them. You need not worry&mdash; They rarely swallow live prey.|Adaroo and Plo Koon|<ref name="TCW8">[[The Clone Wars 8|''The Clone Wars'' 8]]</ref>}}
[[File:Aelids_ahoy_CW8.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Khormai rode within beasts called aelids for long-distance travel.]]
The Khormai inhabited [[City/Legends|villages]] on the [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]]. While a system of conveyances known as [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jets]] connected distant settlements,<ref name="TCW7" /> the Khormai employed local creatures known as [[aelid]]s for transport through difficult, mountainous terrain. Such travel required the Khormai riders to first call the [[Worm/Legends|worms]] with a thin [[Aelid horn|horn]]. They then attached control straps to direct the beasts. However, rather than riding atop the creatures, the Khormai allowed themselves to be swallowed up to direct the creatures from within the worms' [[Stomach/Legends|gullets]] as the creatures burrowed through the soil; aelids rarely digested live prey.<ref name="TCW8" />

The species had access to climate-control technology that was capable of creating vast storms. Khormai tended to wear bulky [[Khormai environment suit|environment suits]] both in the wilds of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="TCW7" /> and aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="DHOSJ" /> The suits were characterized by exhaust pipes in the back that constantly belched black [[Atmosphere/Legends|smoke]]. Other Khormai sported accoutrements such as [[Cape/Legends|capes]]. The ravages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] foregrounded fissures in Khormai society. While some purported to value peace over war, ascribing the latter as the purview of tyrants, others practiced [[Warlord/Legends|warlordism]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of Khormai detractors and [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] to their homeworld. Both factions had access to heavy weaponry with which to fight. The species buried its [[Death/Legends|dead]] in graves dug out from the ice.<ref name="TCW7" />

At least some Khormai demonstrated fluency in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], although they peppered their use of the [[Language/Legends|language]] with idiosyncratic sounds, such as ''tchk-tchk''.<ref name="TCW7" /> Khormai naming conventions allowed both single- and double-part names; examples included Adaroo and Unger Gout.<ref name="TCW8" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Who is commanding the enemy forces?''"<br />"''Shamefully, one of our own. An ambitious warlord cast his lot with Dooku in exchange for control of all we have. Now he enslaves his own people to mine for the Separatists.|Plo Koon and Adaroo|<ref name="TCW7" />}}
[[File:Gout_and_Ventress_CW7.jpg|thumb|left|200px|During the Clone Wars, Unger Gout allied with the Separatists and liaised with Asajj Ventress.]]
The Khormites evolved on the planet Khorm, a chilly world covered in snow and ice.<ref name="TCW7" /> The planet became integrated into [[The galaxy/Legends|the greater galaxy]] at some point between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> when it fell within the [[Halori sector/Legends|Halori sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Khorm system/Legends|Khorm system]]</ref> located within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] reaches of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. As the [[Jedi Civil War]] raged from [[3959 BBY|3959]] to [[3956 BBY]], Khormai fell within [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan's]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. It later lay beyond the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[New Sith Wars]] as well, from [[1004 BBY|1004]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="EA" />

With the outbreak of the Clone Wars, a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict that pitted the Republic against the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Khorm came to the attention of both sides due to its possession of a rare [[Ore/Legends|ore]] known as [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]], which could be used to enhance the power of [[Blaster/Legends|beam weapons]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The warlord [[Unger Gout]] received support from the Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to install himself as the planet's leader. In return, Gout oversaw an [[agrocite processing facility]] in the [[Kafiri Mountain Range]], a forbidding region only accessible via a tortuous overland journey.<ref name="TCW8" /> There he drove a workforce of enslaved Khormai [[Mining/Legends|miners]], whom he forced to collect ore for the Separatist war effort.<ref name="TCW7" />

The Separatists established a base on the world,<ref name="TCW8" /> composed of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] under Gout's command and defended by [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]]s, to protect the warlord and his operation. As an added security measure, Gout employed a [[Weather-control station|climate-control station]] that allowed him to generate massive storms that roiled in Khorm's atmosphere and prevented Republic air strikes.<ref name="TCW7" />

===Battle of Khorm===
{{Main|Battle of Khorm/Legends}}
{{Quote|Clone prisoners are a waste of the resources it takes to guard them. You have much to learn about the Separatist way of war, Warlord.''"<br />"''It is you who have much to learn about the Khormai. We do not kill beings who might be useful as slaves&hellip; or as food for slaves.|Asajj Ventress and Unger Gout|<ref name="TCW7" />}}
[[File:GoutOverseeingKhormai-CW7.jpg|thumb|right|250px|upright|Gout's deal with the Separatists required the enslavement of members of his own species to mine agrocite ore.]]
Gout's actions also fostered the formation of a [[Khormai resistance|resistance movement]], a group of Republic sympathizers led by a Khormai named [[Adaroo]].<ref name="TCW7" /> Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Datenote">''The Clone Wars'' 7 establishes that the stories in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']], including ''The Clone Wars'' 7, ''The Clone Wars'' 8, ''The Clone Wars'' 9, and ''The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju'' take place approximately 22 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Therefore, the events in ''Star Wars: The CLone Wars: In Service of the Republic'' and ''The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju'' must take place in 22 BBY</ref> the resistance leader had identified a vulnerability in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] defenses of Gout's fortress. Meanwhile, the Republic [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] made contact with Adaroo and revealed that a force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] had come to the world under the leadership of himself and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Tauht]]. The Khormai resistance leader remained incredulous of the Republic's motives for intervening in the conflict; he believed that the offworlders sought only access to Khorm's agrocite mining and processing sectors and cared little for the plight of the enslaved Khormai. Nevertheless, he accepted the offworlders' help in the hopes of freeing Gout's captives, and led Koon's command to a soft spot in the Separatists' defenses.<ref name="TCW7" />

Gout witnessed his enemies' approach and ordered fire on nearby ice crystals, which thundered down among the Khormai and Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] in an avalanche. At the same time, the Republic [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], in command of Republic ground forces on the world, ordered the [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] under his command to open fire on the agrocite processing plant where Gout was based. When Ozzel ordered his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers to disembark from their vehicles and attack, the Jedi entered the fray to protect them. As Adaroo, Fisto, and Koon stormed the trenches surrounding the factory and Tauht destroyed the [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], Ozzel ordered his [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] to open fire on Gout's base&mdash;despite the presence of the Jedi. The warlord saw his droid forces greatly reduced; he fled to a separate base within an agrocite mine in his personal rail jet. In his absence, the Republic established its base of operations in the structure.<ref name="TCW7" />

[[File:DSD1DwarfSpiderDroid-TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|The Confederacy employed DSD1 dward spider droids (pictured) during the battle]]
To bolster the Separatist forces on Khorm, the Confederacy's [[Head of State/Legends|leader]], Dooku, sent his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], to support Gout, despite the warlord's protests. When the Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]] notified them that a Separatist starship had somehow entered the atmosphere, the Republic forces surmised that Gout and the Separatists had access to some sort of weather-control technology. A small contingent of troops under the leadership of Adaroo, Fisto, and Koon set out on [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoop bikes]] to destroy the nearby climate-control center, a move that would allow a Republic airstrike to cover the ground troops during a liberation of the mines. Nevertheless, under Ventress's command, Separatist forces led a counter-assault on the agrocite plant. Ozzel and Tauht led the Republic's defense, but the Jedi was killed in the battle. Ozzel ignored his fallen general's orders to defend the center and instead ordered a charge on Ventress's position. Ventress and Gout recognized the Human's folly and activated their awaiting forces of [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], hidden under the snow. They also called up a giant storm, which wiped out entire Khormai villages. Ventress and Gout retook the plant and captured Ozzel; when interrogated, he revealed the whereabouts of Fisto, Plo, Adaroo, and their forces.<ref name="TCW7" />

===In Republic hands===
{{Quote|Master Tauth, the cannon are all yours|Plo Koon|<ref name="TCW7" />}}
Adaroo and the Republic forces reached a decimated [[Unidentified Khormai village|village]], where the resistance leader insisted upon burying the dead before carrying on. The difficult terrain forced the party to dismount from their [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] and instead travel on foot.<ref name="TCW7" /> Despite Ventress's proximity to Adaroo and the Jedi, Gout contacted his underling, the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Villpu Nagg]], who was in charge of the weather-control station. Gout ordered Nagg to generate a storm with enough power to kill the Republic demolition party. Nevertheless, Ventress managed to overtake Adaroo and his companions and laid an ambush for them. During the [[Lightfight|skirmish]], Ventress [[Telekinesis/Legends|created]] an avalanche that buried Republic and Separatist forces alike. The Jedi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to shield their troops and Adaroo from injury. Ventress eventually gave up her search for survivors and departed.<ref name="TCW8" />

The Republic strike team then re-emerged from the snow and destroyed the remaining Separatist droids. With several casualties and injuries, continuing on foot seemed impossible. Instead, Adaroo blew a horn to summon large, furry creatures known as ice worms, in whose gullets the party could continue their trek. Upon arrival, a [[Fixer (clone trooper)|clone trooper]] [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into the station's junction box and refocused the center's storm upon the station itself, a plan Fisto had proposed. The ploy worked: the station was destroyed and the storm dissipated.<ref name="TCW8" />

[[File:Khorm_assault.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi and Adaroo fight in the trenches.]]
Despite the fact that Ozzel and a few other troopers had escaped Gout's prison, the major was ready to surrender once again when the storm dispersed and Republic air forces arrived to turn the tide of the battle.<ref name="TCW8" /> Gout responded by herding the Khormai captives deep into the mines, surrounding himself with sentient shields who could double as hostages. Meanwhile, Adaroo, Fisto, Koon, and their forces returned to the agrocite factory and noticed it was scarcely defended. Nevertheless, Adaroo cautioned that his intelligence had suggested that the interior of the mine was heavily guarded. They proceeded with caution.<ref name="TCW9" />

[[File:Republic_Emblem.svg|thumb|right|200px|Following the battle, the Republic (logo pictured) established a base on the world]]
Ventress, too, soon penetrated the mine and arrived at Gout's location. There, she had a droid line the mine with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal charges]]. Adaroo and the Jedi arrived as that ploy was in progress, and they realized that she intended to demolish the mine&mdash;and kill all the Khormai trapped there&mdash;should the Separatists be forced to abandon the agrocite deposits. Unable to contact Ozzel due to [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] of their communications, the liberators were forced to try to rescue the Khormai before Ventress could detonate her charges. As Ozzel and the Republic craft attacked the warlord's position, Gout replied with his [[agrocite cannon]]s, which turned the tide of battle against the Republic. In the mines, Adaroo joined Koon and his clone troopers in an attempt to subdue Ventress and free the captives while Fisto and the clone trooper [[Sharp]] assaulted Gout's cannons. As Koon confronted Ventress in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]], Adaroo and the troops reached the enslaved Khormai only to discover they were heavily guarded. Meanwhile, Fisto and Sharp reached Gout's cannons. Panicked, Gout ordered all droid troops to his position, which left Adaroo and his troops with little resistance back in the mines. Fisto and Sharp neutralized the cannons, and the resulting explosion killed the Khormai warlord. The Separatist cause lost, Ventress fled, leaving the world in Republic hands. With the captives freed, Adaroo agreed to supply agrocite for the Republic. The Republic established a base on the world near the agrocite processing plant.<ref name="TCW9" />

===Later history===
Khorm remained in Republic space during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] of [[20 BBY/Legends|20]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Years later, in [[7 ABY/Legends|7]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Khormai home planet was within a region largely dominated by vassals or allies of Warlord [[Zsinj]], a Human who attempted to rebuild the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with him at its head. The species' homeworld was part of the Trans-Hydian during the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], and it was within the territory of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] by [[137 ABY]].<ref name="EA" />

==Khormai in the galaxy==
At least some Khormai left their homeworld; for instance,<ref name="DHOSJ" /> circa 22 BBY,<ref name="Datenote" /> [[Unidentified Khormai 1|two]] [[Unidentified Khormai 2|Khormai]] were patrons of a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] within a [[Attuma Duum's headquarters|base]] hidden within an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] near [[Cavamina Minor]]. There, the Khormai witnessed the destruction of Republic and Separatist flotillas that had been lured into the mined asteroid field by the base's owner, [[Attuma Duum]]. When a Human named [[Shon-Ju]] infiltrated Duum's base and disabled its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], the station itself came under threat of the mined asteroids and was destroyed.<ref name="DHOSJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Khormai first appeared in the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]], the first issue of a [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic|three-part story arc]]<ref name="TCW7" /> that was published in [[July 15]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-238/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-7|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #7}}</ref> The story was written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and the artwork was penciled by [[Scott Hepburn]].<ref name="TCW7" />
